context:
Follow the pattern established by ModinDataFrameAdapter in
benchbox/platforms/dataframe/modin_df.py (~500 lines). These are thin
adapters that:
1. Extend PandasFamilyAdapter with platform-specific I/O overrides
2. Use try/except import for availability detection (BODO_AVAILABLE flag)
3. Override read_csv, read_parquet, to_datetime, and timedelta_days
4. Inherit all query execution, aggregation, and validation from the base class

Start with modin_df.py as the closest reference since Modin also provides
a Pandas-compatible API with a different execution backend.
description:
Implement Bodo as a new DataFrame platform adapter in the Pandas family.
Bodo is a high-performance computing engine that provides automatic
parallelization and optimization of Python/Pandas code using Numba JIT
compilation. It enables distributed execution of Pandas workloads across
multiple cores and nodes without requiring code changes.

The adapter should extend PandasFamilyAdapter, following the same pattern
used by Modin, Dask, and cuDF adapters. Since Bodo provides a Pandas-compatible
API, the majority of functionality is inherited from the base class, with
overrides needed primarily for I/O operations and distributed initialization.

anti_patterns.dont: add @bodo.jit decorators directly in adapter methods
anti_patterns.why: the adapter must work with or without JIT

anti_patterns.dont: add bodo as a required project dependency
anti_patterns.instead: use conditional imports with BODO_AVAILABLE flag
keep all Bodo-specific code in bodo_df.py
anti_patterns.why: Bodo is just another consumer of the base class

anti_patterns.dont: require Bodo installation for unit tests
anti_patterns.why: Bodo has heavy dependencies (MPI, Numba) not available in CI

deferrals.reason: JIT compilation is Bodo's main value proposition but adds significant complexity. Start with Bodo's Pandas-compatible I/O only; add JIT support as a follow-up once the basic adapter is validated.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Exact match: open item bodo-jit-and-mpi-support explicitly covers @bodo.jit compilation follow-up.

deferrals.reason: Multi-node execution requires mpiexec launch and cluster setup. Initial adapter targets single-node multi-core parallelism only.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Bodo MPI multi-node execution is exactly the scope of open item bodo-jit-and-mpi-support.
